## Activity

During December 2022, Hill Counties Health Centre recorded 64 captures. This activity provides the basis for the site operations review and indicates the volume of imaging completed during the month. The capture total should be considered alongside the image-quality results and the subsequent grading outcomes.

## Image quality

Of the 64 captures, 6 were ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 9.4. The ungradable images could not be used for grading and therefore reduced the number of captures available for assessment. Recurring camera issues should be logged with the service desk, as requested by the clinic lead.

## Grading

The grading results identified 9 referable cases. The median lag between capture and grading was 1 day. Together, these results summarise the grading activity for December 2022 at Hill Counties Health Centre. The site should continue to record image-quality issues and grading performance through routine operational reporting so that recurring problems remain visible and can be followed up through the appropriate service arrangements.
